prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one STATIC high-fidelity UI design image for xdnote, a modern cross-platform local Markdown reader/editor.
The supplied reference is VISUAL STYLE REFERENCE, not a screenshot to copy verbatim. Preserve its warm-white/pale-gray surfaces, graphite controls, refined Chinese typography, thin outline icons, 6px control corners, hairline neutral dividers and spacious uncluttered desktop proportions. Product name is now EXACTLY "xdnote", not "Markdown". Use a tiny outlined folded-document icon beside the product label.
LIGHT tokens: surface #FFFFFF, navigation #F4F5F7, text #1F2937, secondary #667085, accent #374151 with white text, soft selection #EBECEE. DARK tokens when requested: background #1B1F25, surface #22272F, text #E6EAF0, secondary #AAB4C0, accent #B3BDCC with #171A21 text. Semantic green saved checks, amber warnings and muted red errors are independent of accent. Never use teal as the app accent.
Crisp straight-on orthographic desktop UI, complete product bounds, landscape 3:2 canvas at very high resolution. A slim quiet outer margin; no devices, perspective, photographic props, marketing slogans, illustrations unrelated to reading, fake metrics, account/AI/cloud panes, watermarks or long outside annotations. Simplified Chinese must be correct and clearly readable, with comfortable product-sized text and consistent alignment.
Use standard monochrome Windows window controls except in the explicit cross-platform board. Do not show a running implementation, code frameworks, licenses/versions not supplied, or testing results. All controls and feedback should look like practical shipping product design.
For multi-panel boards, all panels are equally polished. Separate panels with a generous neutral gutter, no overlaps. Each panel gets only a short Chinese state label OUTSIDE its product surface. Keep enough size for actual controls and their text. No arrows or explanatory prose inside the product.
Shared sample document: filename "写作，从这里开始.md"; parent "文档 / 个人笔记"; title "写作，从这里开始"; paragraph "把想法写下来，让思考慢慢清晰。"; quote "少一点干扰，多一点专注。"; heading "一个安静的写作空间"; task list "记录一个新的想法", "整理本周的阅读笔记", "留一点时间，自由写作". Source and preview content must correspond when both shown.

Composition: exactly TWO equally sized product panels, LEFT and RIGHT, with a clear vertical gutter and short state labels above. Each panel is fully in frame. Aim for two tall desktop windows, not overlapping screenshots.

BOARD: 外观与阅读设置
Panel 1, label "外观与配色": Same settings shell 外观与配色 selected. Three appearance miniatures 浅色 深色 跟随系统; follow-system selected. Six clear swatches 石墨灰#374151, 雾蓝#526B95, 钴蓝#356AE6, 灰紫#7B668F, 陶土#A45C46, 橄榄#68764B, graphite selected. Compact live control preview with primary button, file selection, toggle. Note 配色同步应用到所有窗口. Footer 完成.

Panel 2, label "阅读与渲染": Same settings shell 阅读与渲染 selected. 字体 系统字体, 字号16, 行距1.8, 正文宽度760, 显示大纲 ON, 代码高亮 跟随界面, 网络图片 默认不加载. Small typographic preview with heading, paragraph and quote. Settings apply immediately, no duplicate Save.
